coordinates: top-left, x-right, y-down; one sprite pixel per physical rest cell

walk.runtime_display: Supplied idle pose; user-authored walk art pending. Legacy derived poses are not cycled in the live build.

chew.driver: fr_player_chew_tick; valid target and held intent

cast.event: fr_player_take_cast_event; latched once crossing 400ms, even when samples skip frame 6; 640ms total
cast.timing_provenance: Explicit runtime override; original ASE timing and artwork bytes preserved.

physical_tuning: Provisional: fur, robe, hat and tail alias the existing wettable combustible wood profile; teeth alias stone. These are explicit placeholder coefficients, not claims of measured cloth or fur properties. All 15 packed body material IDs are currently assigned; no ID is truncated or reused for a new physical substance.
appearance: Linear RGB in compiled records; independent from physical material. Alpha zero is transparent. Surface defaults remain renderer-owned (surface_mask zero).
canonical_mapping: Each frame has a parallel row-major u32 plane: zero means transparent, otherwise canonical source row*40+column+1. Exported .source.u32 files are little-endian. Frame occlusion may hide a source texel; hidden canonical parcels must remain owned, not be erased or recreated.
animation_policy: CPRP state_variants explicitly records changing silhouettes. Do not place each variant into the world as new matter. Runtime deformation/rendering must reference existing canonical material parcels through source mapping.
ownership: Each player requires a distinct actual runtime body/generation and a stable appearance identity. Share only immutable clip bytes/maps. fr_beaver_pixel_owners_trimmed applies an explicit admission rest origin/extent, preserving canonical appearance coordinates and resolving actual BODY rest coordinates. Fractured or repartitioned bodies require updated bindings from their actual admission metadata.
runtime_status: Live keyboard/controller routing, GPU body drive, cropped animation rendering and named fire-ray demo are integrated. Canonical parcels persist; collision/exposure still use canonical rest geometry. Full animated material deformation, conservative harvesting and split-screen remain unfinished.

runtime_crop.bounds: Exact nonzero-alpha bounds per frame, retaining every visible effect pixel. Original CPRP source canvases remain 40x40 or 80x40; GPU atlas frames are trimmed.
runtime_crop.contact: Reviewed fur-paw contact, excluding tail and staff; common admitted-body support edge with explicit frame/mirror offsets.
runtime_crop.ownership: Cropping preserves all canonical source IDs and reactive owner keys.

artwork: Authoritative chew and cast ASE pixels preserved exactly, including cast partial alpha and 80x40 canvas. Six walk poses derive from imported idle. No separately visible tooth region is invented.
